{{Quote|Yeaahhh!!|The Rodian and several other pariahs|<ref name="TOO" />}}
A '''Rodian''' was a member of a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|group of pariahs]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] during the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was one of many outcasts who were preparing to fight the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] and his small [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|force]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], who had arrived on the planet to create an outpost that would be used as a staging point for the next phase of the Clone Wars.

[[Gaan]], the leader of the [[City/Legends|settlement]], ordered that the outcasts take to the rooftops, while he would confront the Republic in the streets in order to kill the Jedi himself. Before the fight could begin, however, the [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]], [[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]], received the command to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]; an order that branded the Jedi as traitors to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and that the Jedi were to be executed on sight immediately. The clone troopers opened fire on both Sah and Gaan, which prompted the settlers to attack the clone troopers. The Rodian was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the ensuing [[Battle of Ragmar V|firefight]] by Remy.

==Biography==
===Early life and the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|We're in for a tough fight, but we will stand our ground. They want to bring their war to our home... then repay them in kind.|Gaan to the Rodian and several other pariahs|<ref name="TOO" />}}
[[File:BattleOfRagmarV.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The settlement's residents fought against the clones.]]
A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] lived during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point they joined a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement]] of pariahs on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]]. They were still there<ref name="TOO" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During that final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Date" /> between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic armies]] arrived on Ragmar V, in order to construct an outpost that would be used as a staging point for an upcoming attack against the Separatists. The settlement's leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], detested the Republic's presence, and ordered a [[Unidentified Klatooinian outcast 1|Klatooinian]] to fire a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] at a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that had just landed on a nearby mesa. The gunship's occupants, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Joc Sah]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under his command, survived the blast and started to make their way to the settlement.<ref name="TOO" />

Gaan rounded up the Rodian and a number of the other residents in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and told them of the situation. Gaan explained they were going to make a stand against the Republic forces, with Gaan making a special note that he wanted to kill the Jedi himself. The criminals responded enthusiastically, ready to fight. The Rodian, the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], a [[Unidentified Bith outcast|Bith]], and a [[Unidentified red-headed Human female outcast|Human]] all took positions on top of a building overlooking the main street and waited for Gaan's signal to fire.<ref name="TOO" />

===Order 66 and death===
{{Quote|Take 'em out!|A Klatooinian gives the order to fire on Remy|<ref name="TOO" />}}
[[File:Rodian_Outcast_Gets_Blasted.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Rodian is killed by Sergeant Remy]]
Gaan met the Jedi and his clones in the street, but before the battle could even begin, the Jedi's [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]], [[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]], received the command to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Order 66 was an order that branded all Jedi as traitors to the Republic and that they were to be immediately [[Death/Legends|executed]]. The clones opened fire on Sah, and Gaan mistakenly believed his men had opened fire without his signal. When he realized it was the clones, he killed one of them out of a brief flash of anger, as he had wanted to kill the Jedi himself. This action caused the clones to [[Battle of Ragmar V|attack]] Gaan, forcing him to take cover with Sah.<ref name="TOO" />

The Klatooinian gave their own order to the settlers to fire upon the clones, and several clones were quickly dispatched as Remy and a few others took shelter. Remy returned fire and killed the Rodian with a single shot to the chest. Gaan and Sah finished off Remy and the rest of his clones, and then began preparing to fight a larger force that would arrive to ensure Sah's demise. The Rodian was the only casualty after the fight with Remy's men.<ref name="TOO" />

==Personality and traits==
A Rodian, they had large [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and lumpy green skin,<ref name="TOO" /> which were common traits among Rodians.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The Rodian appeared to enjoy the idea of fighting the Republic troops, as they were just as enthusiastic about fighting the troopers as the other outcasts when Gaan explained the battle plan.<ref name="TOO" />

==Equipment==
The Rodian carried a small silver [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] during the fight with Remy's troops, and had fired it at the clone troopers before they were killed. They also wore a blue uniform with gold trimmings that appeared military in nature, with a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]] strapped around their waist that had several pouches.<ref name="TOO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian was created for the short story ''[[The Order of Outcasts]]'', which was one of four stories compiled into the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series. ''The Order of Outcasts'' was written by [[Matt Jacobs]], was illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]],<ref name="TOO" /> and was published on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-402/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-5-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 5 TPB}}</ref>
